lines.text: Right now, somewhere, a job is changing.
Maybe yours.
We can't promise to fix that.
But we can promise a percentage.
We built a thing that thinks so fast
it's rewriting what we do,
and some of what it's changing
is the work that pays for you.
So we gathered here this morning
in a studio we own,
to give away a part of us
to a fund we keep at home.
It's not a charity, per se,
it's an LLC, wholly owned,
flexible, adjustable,
the details will be shown...
In the coming months!
Share the shares, share the shares,
five in every hundred, we'll be there.
And if we grow by half again,
two more at our discretion then.
The more we grow, the more we give,
so help us grow, so we can give.
The more we grow, the more we give,
the more we give,
so help us grow, so we can give.
Now you might ask who holds the purse,
who signs and who decides
which cause is worthy, which is not,
and who sits on which side.
Each milestone's measured from a line
we haven't drawn just yet,
but trust us, it's a generous line,
the best one you can get.
Not for lobbying, not for campaigns,
not for politics, we swear...
Through this fund!
through this fund.
Share the shares, share the shares,
five in every hundred, we'll be there.
And if we grow by half again,
two more at our discretion then.
The more we grow, the more we give,
so help us grow, so we can give.

lines.text: and whether I get a say.
And it's real, it isn't nothing:
a fifth of us, all told,
set aside for something bigger
than the ones who bought and sold.
If a promise holds while holding's cheap,
then watch us when it's not.
When it's not!
When it's not!
When it's not!
Share the shares, share the shares,
five in every hundred, we'll be there.
And if we grow by half again,
two more at our discretion then.
The more we grow, the more we give,
do I get a say?
So help us grow, so we can give.
The more we grow, the more we give,
the more we grow, the more we give,
the more we grow...

shots.picture: Retired at C5 (it didn't fit the video). It was the real generation screen: the style prompt, lyrics and take list
Slow push into a certificate lying on a desk. SHARE THE SHARES resolves in engraved capitals

shots.cue: "Right now, somewhere, a job is changing."
shots.picture: *Progress* steps out of the top vignette, torch raised, and speaks to camera
The cherubs in the four corners turn their heads toward camera in unison
*Progress* gestures; a small "%" glyph engraves itself into the torch flame

shots.cue: "We built a thing that thinks so fast"
shots.picture: Wide on the certificate. *Progress* sings; behind her the vignette is an engraved recording studio

shots.cue: "is the work that pays for you"
shots.picture: Close on the engraved laborer in the lower corner, still, hammer raised
The engraved studio door; its plaque reads WHOLLY OWNED

shots.cue: "to a fund we keep at home"
shots.picture: Push into a tiny certificate drawn inside the first, then into a tinier one inside that
*Mercury* sprints along the border; the fine print scrolls under his feet like a ticker
Extreme close-up on the guilloche, which resolves into LLC LLC LLC
The cherubs shout; an engraved calendar in the margin flips pages and never lands
Wide: the cherub choir sways along the top border. A small LIVE bug in telethon style sits in the corner
The corner denominations flip from 5 to 5%
*Prudence* raises a finger; a "+2%" stamp hovers over the page and is pulled back unstamped

shots.cue: "The more we grow, the more we give"

shots.cue: "so help us grow, so we can give"

shots.cue: "Now you might ask who holds the purse"

She studies it, then erases it; eraser crumbs drift down the page
She draws it again as a faint dotted line, and smiles
*Mercury* reads from an unrolled scroll
The certificate flips to its back: the transfer form, and a second document face down underneath. The camera turns away before it can be read
The choir sways; the LIVE bug blinks

shots.cue: "They call me a specific population" through "and whether I get a say"
shots.picture: One continuous take, guitar and voice, one mic. Locked-off medium shot; the sheet lies face down beside you, the printed transfer form facing up. Overlay: "Post-filter: no change"
You turn the sheet face up. The music comes back mid-phrase. Push into the paper
The stub on the left becomes a thermometer, its perforations marked in +50% steps

shots.cue: "than the ones who bought and sold"

The corporate seal stamps down and embosses the page

Close on *Prudence*, scissors raised

shots.cue: "The more we grow (the more we give)"
shots.picture: Slow pull back across the whole certificate as "Fully paid and non-assessable" glows
*Progress* leans out of a filing-cabinet drawer labeled WHOLLY OWNED, says the line, and the drawer slides shut
You pick up your phone and dial the pledge number printed along the certificate's bottom edge
The chorus as muzak plays down the line. You listen, hang up, fold the certificate in half and slide it into your guitar case
The fact card in engraved type
The real announcement page, then the "Derived from" credits
